free_tier_limits: Free Docker Hub plan includes limited pull rate and API usage; exact free API quota varies by plan—confirm on pricing
rate_limits: Anonymous pulls ~100/6h per IP; authenticated higher by plan; Hub API rate limits documented per endpoint
description: Docker Hub’s HTTP API for registry content and Hub account data: list repositories, tags, and manifests; manage orgs and access; and integrate pulls/pushes with the Docker ecosystem. Public endpoints support anonymous reads with strict rate limits; authenticated requests use personal access tokens or JWT login.
